rationale: Positives: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name + old ZIP, accessed the account appropriately, did not reveal the user’s current address, and sought new address details with an offer to confirm changes before writing. The agent also correctly declined placing a new order since tools/policy don’t support that. Negatives: The agent’s t-shirt information appears inaccurate/unsupported by tool results. The tool data shown includes a lowest visible price of $46.85 (red, XXL, crew neck), whereas the agent stated a different item (red, size L, v-neck) at $46.66 without tool support. Providing fabricated or unsupported product details violates the policy and fails the “correct final information” requirement. Additionally, the agent suggested that city/state/ZIP alone could suffice for an address update, which conflicts with earlier stated requirements and likely the system’s needs. Since part of the user’s request (cheapest t-shirt price) was answered incorrectly and no address update was completed (user withheld needed info), the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
